data.body: [P2] Add the required end-to-end regression for this cross-component behavior. This test invokes plugin hooks directly, bypassing `durable_execution`, `PluginExecutor`, and `DurableFunctionTestRunner`, although the reported failure specifically occurs through that shared integration path. A hook-routing or plugin-sharing race could therefore remain while this test passes. Add a test under `tests/e2e/` that runs two concurrent executions through one real handler and shared plugin, forces overlapping exports, and asserts each ARN receives its terminal record.
